simulation_details.forcing: Observed Q discharge source + CMFD 0.25deg daily precipitation

flood_results.physical_validation: Max depth 4.18m is consistent with Huai River floodplain major flood; water accumulates along low-elevation river channel corridors; comparable to Bengbu validation (6.99m max at 100m res with 390mm precip)

metrics.note: SFINCS is a 2D flood model producing spatial inundation maps, not point discharge. Validation is against flood extent/depth physical reasonableness, not against obs Q.

issues: CRITICAL: KI topobathy tool generates mask=3 for interior cells, but SFINCS binary uses mask=1 for active cells. mask=3 is INVALID in SFINCS — the model treats these cells as inactive, producing zero flooding. The Bengbu validation used mask=1 (likely manually set), masking the bug.
Source discharge (srcfile/disfile) boundary condition was never validated by KI — both Chaohe and Bengbu tests used precipitation only.
Precipitation file must start at t=0.0 with 3-hourly timesteps (matching Bengbu format). KI prepare_sfincs_rainfall tool outputs NetCDF, but SKILL.md says use ASCII precipfile — format inconsistency.
No KI tool exists for converting observed discharge to SFINCS src/dis boundary conditions. cama_to_sfincs_boundary.py only handles CaMa-Flood output.

ki_gaps.description: SKILL.md and build_sfincs_topobathy.py use mask=3 for 'active interior cells', but SFINCS v2.3.2 binary uses mask=1 for active. mask=3 is treated as inactive, producing zero flooding — a completely silent error.
ki_gaps.fix: Change build_sfincs_topobathy.py line 147 from 'msk[basin_mask == 1] = 3' to 'msk[basin_mask == 1] = 1', and lines 158 from 'msk[edge] = 2' to appropriate boundary encoding. Also update all mask documentation in SKILL.md.

ki_gaps.description: No tool for converting observed discharge time series to SFINCS src/dis boundary conditions. cama_to_sfincs_boundary.py only handles CaMa-Flood NetCDF output.
ki_gaps.fix: Add --obs_file option to cama_to_sfincs_boundary.py or create obs_to_sfincs_boundary.py

ki_gaps.description: prepare_sfincs_rainfall.py outputs NetCDF, but SKILL.md dt_v004 says use ASCII precipfile. generate_sfincs_inp.py writes 'precipfile' (ASCII keyword). This mismatch would cause SFINCS to silently ignore rainfall from the rainfall tool.
ki_gaps.fix: Change prepare_sfincs_rainfall.py to output ASCII format (time_seconds precip_mmhr) consistent with generate_sfincs_inp.py and validated Bengbu format.

ki_gaps.description: Neither validated test (Chaohe, Bengbu) used discharge source boundary conditions (srcfile/disfile). Both used precipitation-only forcing. The src/dis coupling path was untested.
ki_gaps.fix: Add a validation test case using discharge source BCs (e.g., from observed Q or CaMa-Flood output).

ki_gaps.description: SKILL.md Section 4 documents mask values as {0=inactive, 1=boundary inflow, 2=outflow, 3=active}. The actual SFINCS v2.3.2 encoding is {0=inactive, 1=active, 2=outflow boundary}. This documentation error propagated to the topobathy tool.
ki_gaps.fix: Correct SKILL.md mask value documentation. Verify against SFINCS source code.
